submission.comment: After extensive testing across all 5 strategy families (momentum, ma_crossover, mean_reversion, breakout, rsi) with various parameter combinations and modifiers (long_only, vol_target), the best strategy found is a long-only mean reversion strategy with volatility targeting. Parameters: lookback=75 days, entry_z=1.0. This achieves an annualized Sharpe of 0.89 with 18.7% annual return, 21.1% annual volatility, and 22.9% max drawdown. Despite testing ~420 strategy variations, no strategy achieved Sharpe > 1.0 on this dataset. The mean reversion family with long_only and vol_target consistently outperformed other families.
